EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Source, who has direct and regular access in Torvik, reported that ostravik (A-411) and Kalvar (A-417) berth at quay 4.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Ostravik (A-411), Kalvar (A-417), 3rd Naval Auxiliary Group.

3. Source noted that instructions were passed verbally rather than through the usual written schedule, which source considered unusual.

4. Source reported that normal working arrangements were suspended for the duration and that access to the area was controlled by personnel source did not recognise.

5. Source assessed approximately 20 personnel involved, drawn from military rather than civilian establishment, which source described as without precedent in 6 months of access.

6. Source was not able to establish the destination of the activity, nor whether it was directed or routine.
